mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (relative to its 12-month moving average) signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (relative to 12-month moving average) falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity investors to anticipate weaker corporate earnings and sell equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE has risen >0.3pp in 3 months are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong manufacturing output (INDPRO above its 12-month moving average) signals an overheating economy that prompts the Federal Reserve to accelerate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in instances meeting the trigger condition are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the joint condition falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below its 3-month moving average signals a weakening housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines below its 3-month moving average are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS (relative to 12-month moving average) falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward returns in periods where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (the 2017 base) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in instances where INDPRO < 100.0 are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25pp in 3 months) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL > 2.5%
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in instances meeting the trigger condition are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the joint condition falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion, a rise in real GDP (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in early-cycle expansion periods when GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
